title: mdfc_land_and_suspend golden flakes with pass_priority timeout under memory pressure
description:
The mdfc_land_and_suspend golden test intermittently fails with a pass_priority timeout (119.6s) on CI. In the failing run, the spectator process consumed 2449 MiB of RSS (total 4477 MiB across all processes), suggesting memory pressure on the GitHub Actions runner.

The hang occurs during replay at pass_priority with board_cursor=13. The opponent concedes (RPC #218) while the player's pass_priority (RPC #120) is still waiting, and pass_priority eventually returns after 119.6s but exceeds the Python-side timeout.

The same commit passed on a parallel CI run, confirming this is a nondeterministic flake rather than a deterministic regression.

Possible causes:
- Memory pressure from the spectator process (2449 MiB) causing GC pauses or swapping that delays callback delivery
- A race in the keepAlive loop where the previous game's cleanup interferes with callback processing
- The bridge's 200ms actionLock.wait() polling loop missing a callback under load
